annotations.text:
Phase 1 mockup for the Discovery Canvas (spec v0.3, section 17).
Landing: workshop Gimbal full-bleed, tab tiles as glass, inbox and flag counts, recent activity.
Canvas tab: glass top bar with tabs, drawer (unplaced + inbox), React Flow-style canvas over the blurred dusk image, one frame, entity and native cards, typed edges, inspector for the selected statement.
Same layout in both themes; tokens from the sampled palette.
Card copy is real discovery material (S26, S31, S39, KB-2, Sections B and D); counts and activity are sample values.
